sources.title: Kenya Times, 22 June 1988, pp.16–17
sources.role_and_limits: Original newspaper-page reproduction; visually read. Journalist Job Mutungi. Photograph credited in article to Francis Kaburu. Host is Ilias Chrissochoidis personal page, not Stanford endorsement.

sources.title: Sunday Times (Kenya), 26 June 1988, pp.12,17
sources.role_and_limits: Original page reproduction; visually read. By Nyaga wa Muto and Ben Mutiuka. Includes attributed arrival account and theological objections; neither is a controlled experiment.

sources.title: Nairobi newspaper reproduction index
sources.role_and_limits: Index; not an independent eyewitness. Summary does not preserve all attribution distinctions.

sources.title: The Theosophist, February 1890 supplement, ci–cii
sources.role_and_limits: Downloaded complete issue supplement; relevant two pages read; cii rendered and visually inspected. Monk Rambuppola Pannasara testimony with H.S. Olcott commentary; Olcott a Theosophical advocate, not a physicist conducting calibrated tests.

sources.title: The Buddhist Ray, August 1888, p.64
sources.role_and_limits: Reprint of H. Sumangala letter dated 4 June 1887; he cites pupils, not personal presence.

sources.title: UPI, Gods drink milk in India, 22 September 1995
sources.role_and_limits: Contemporary wire; named pro and contrary participant observations; explicit religious interpretation.

sources.title: AP, Reports Of Hindu Miracle Draws Millions To Temples, 22 September 1995
sources.role_and_limits: Contemporary AP reprint; crowd estimates not direct-witness census.

sources.title: Times of India, 22 September 1995, reprinted in earlier research
sources.role_and_limits: See ../comparative-public-miracles-20261028/hinduism/sources.json and sources/times_of_india_19950922_reprint.html. Office plastic-object replication and temple runoff/dye reports; original quantitative data not recovered.

sources.title: Colonist, 24 September 1903, p.4, News Items
sources.role_and_limits: Indexed archival OCR located and read in web results; direct-page fetch failed. No original page image inspected. Confirms pre-outcome prayer challenge, not divine cause.

sources.title: Dictionary of National Biography, 1912 supplement, John Alexander Dowie
sources.role_and_limits: Near-contemporary biographical account of decline and death, with references; not eyewitness of prayer efficacy.

sources.title: AFP, Buddha rays spark statue-gazing, 2 August 2006
sources.role_and_limits: Contemporary wire reprint; electronics engineer R. Weerasekara reports seeing rays and optical interpretation, not recovered experimental study.

sources.title: PTI, Millions gaze at Buddha statue, 2 August 2006
sources.role_and_limits: Contemporary wire reprint; describes gazing-dependent line at statue color boundary and religious disagreement.

sources.title: O.M. Jacob Nandi, University of Nairobi MA thesis, 1993
sources.role_and_limits: Catalog/abstract indexed. Full PDF requests failed. No thesis conclusion about the 1988 event is claimed.

sources.title: T. Jayaraman, Behind the milk-drinking miracle
sources.author_background: Institute of Mathematical Sciences, Madras, author affiliation stated in article
sources.access: full_live_text_read; existing download in prior research
sources.role_and_limits: First-person account of witnessing a demonstration; proposed mass-balance test is not a reported complete quantitative original-temple experiment. Polemical universal dismissals are not treated as measurements.

sources.title: Collins Kweyu, I did not bring Jesus to Nairobi – Akatsa, The Standard, 1 November 2013
sources.access: Page downloaded; title, byline and date readable. Body behind premium overlay in downloaded text; substantive quotations recovered through indexed search excerpt, not full article reading.
sources.role_and_limits: Indexed excerpt quotes Akatsa saying the Indian-looking visitor only came for prayers and that enemies misrepresented the incident. A 25-year-later attributed denial; not original recorded interview, not independent proof of visitor identity or deliberate staging. Compare with the June1988 eyewitness coverage before adjudication.
